description: Dated basic residential illustrative rate snapshots checked against legislation and official guidance. Revalidate before professional reliance. Special transactions refused.
verified_for: simple residential purchase, unlinked, not mixed use, one purchaser tax profile, no relief, no corporate flat rate, no overseas purchaser and no lease-rent NPV; no contract-date transition applies
source_fidelity_warning: This is not a complete SDLT or LTT engine. The rate bands and listed effective dates were checked against the cited legislation and official guidance on 2026-10-28. Verify current rates, facts, reliefs, exemptions, and contract-date transitional rules at the actual effective date. An expression of option to tax, lease rents, mixed property, linked purchases, company buyer, non-UK resident buyer or other special facts must stop calculation. The additional flag selects a rate table; it does not decide whether higher rates apply.
